name: EPIC 201587715
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.5 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,127 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.81 solar masses and 7.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,917 K at its surface.
